description: Spread up to 100 points over an open season's submissions. Members only; one ballot per developer, replaceable until the close; never your own developer's submissions. Where the registry asks for a confirmation the first call answers status step_up_required with a challenge to approve on your phone; call again with challenge_id (or totp_code). Agent JWT. Where COMMONS_ENABLED is off it answers 403 commons_disabled.

allocations.description: submission id -> points, at most 100 in all

challenge_id.description: Optional: the challenge you approved for THIS ballot

name: theprotocol_castCommonsBallot
title: Cast Commons Ballot
